featuredProjects.title: My World — 3D Interactive Portfolio
featuredProjects.tagline: Spatial residential district portfolio built with React & Three.js
featuredProjects.description: An open-world, peaceful 3D residential neighborhood where visitors explore portfolio projects, skills, education, and achievements by controlling a third-person character in real-time.
featuredProjects.contribution: Conceived the architectural concept, engineered the third-person character controller, physics collision system with Rapier, multi-level building interiors, and customized daylighting shaders.
highlights: 6 fully connected distinct architectural buildings with accessible interiors
Custom third-person camera with intelligent wall-clipping collision avoidance
Continuous walkable neighborhood with zero loading screens
Seamless entrance portals and decoupled JSON-driven content architecture

featuredProjects.title: CloudFlow — Distributed Task & Workflow Engine
featuredProjects.tagline: Real-time workflow orchestration platform for engineering teams
featuredProjects.description: A high-concurrency event-driven pipeline manager that visualizes microservice workflows, automates job retries, and delivers live telemetry metrics over WebSockets.
featuredProjects.contribution: Architected the end-to-end event queue using Redis and BullMQ, implemented DAG dependency visualizer with React Flow, and built REST/GraphQL endpoints with automated role-based access control.
highlights: Processed over 500,000 simulated tasks per hour in performance benchmarks
Interactive node graph UI with drag-and-drop workflow builder
Real-time WebSocket event streaming with automatic reconnection
Full test coverage with Jest, Supertest, and Playwright E2E

featuredProjects.title: Aura — 3D Audio Visualizer & Soundscape Studio
featuredProjects.tagline: Real-time Web Audio API synthesizer with spatial sound positioning
featuredProjects.description: An interactive digital audio workstation in the browser featuring binaural audio spatialization, parametric equalizer visualizer, and generative particle effects reactive to sound frequencies.
featuredProjects.contribution: Engineered Web Audio API DSP pipeline, implemented FFT frequency analysis hooked into custom WebGL shader uniforms, and developed clean preset manager stored in IndexedDB.
highlights: Binaural 3D listener coordinate tracking reactive to mouse or headphone sensors
60 FPS GPU-accelerated frequency spectrum particle visualizer
Zero-latency audio routing graph with modular effect nodes
Offline caching and audio export support via Web Audio Renderers

featuredProjects.title: Artisan — Headless E-Commerce & Inventory Suite
featuredProjects.tagline: High-conversion headless storefront with optimistic checkout
featuredProjects.description: A modern headless commerce solution built for independent designer studios, featuring instant search indexing, optimistic cart mutations, Stripe payments, and automated inventory sync.
featuredProjects.contribution: Developed the headless storefront UI, integrated Stripe Payment Element with Webhook event reconciliation, and configured Algolia instant search with faceted filtering.
highlights: Sub-100ms instant search queries with typo tolerance
Optimistic UI updates delivering seamless cart modifications
Comprehensive inventory tracking with low-stock webhooks
Achieved 99/100 Lighthouse performance score across mobile and desktop
